findings.title: Full any/any/any permit
findings.where: security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p1
findings.recommendation: Restrict source, destination and application to the strict minimum (least privilege). A permit any/any/any defeats the point of filtering.
fix: # delete security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p1
# set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p1 match source-address <SRC_OBJECT>
# set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p1 match destination-address <DST_OBJECT>
# set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p1 match application <APP>

findings.title: SSH root-login allowed
findings.recommendation: Forbid direct root login via SSH.
fix: set system services ssh root-login deny

findings.title: host-inbound-traffic system-services = all
findings.recommendation: Only allow the management services strictly necessary inbound on the zone (never 'all', especially on an external zone). Exposing 'all' publishes every service of the engine.
fix: delete security zones security-zone trust host-inbound-traffic system-services all
# then add only what's needed, e.g.:
# set security zones security-zone trust host-inbound-traffic system-services ping

findings.title: Permit with no logging
findings.where: security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p1
fix: set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p1 then log session-close

findings.title: No remote logging (syslog host)
findings.recommendation: Send logs to an external collector/SIEM (traceability, retention, correlation).
fix: # set system syslog host <SIEM_IP> any info

findings.title: No login banner
findings.recommendation: Display a legal warning at login.
fix: # set system login message "Access restricted - authorized use only"

findings.title: NTP not configured
findings.recommendation: Synchronize the clock (essential for log timestamping).

findings.title: Internal zone with no screen
findings.recommendation: Even a minimal screen (ip-spoofing) on internal zones is a useful defense in depth.
